actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
auth.description: Follow [these instructions](https://documentation.bamboohr.com/docs/getting-started#authentication) to get your API key
auth.props.companyDomain.description: The subdomain used to access BambooHR. If you access BambooHR at https://mycompany.bamboohr.com, then the companyDomain is "mycompany"
triggers.reportFieldChanged.description: Triggers when a specific field in a BambooHR report changes for any employee.
triggers.reportFieldChanged.props.fieldT: The name of the field to watch for changes (e.g., "department", "jobTitle", "status")
triggers.reportFieldChanged.props.report: The ID of the BambooHR report to monitor (e.g., "1", "2", etc.)
